verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a JavaScript/TypeScript engine whose public programmatic API is the product. The evidence covers each element of the story: typed, documented API reference (typedoc class pages, TypeScript with full IntelliSense), public NPM packages for all modules, and headless/server-side driving via NullEngine. Independent users praise the documentation and backwards compatibility, and llms.txt files are served for AI consumption. missing for 10: no machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes 404), docs are client-rendered with no .md mirrors for agents to ingest, little first-party guidance aimed at AI-agent-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
